ns2:course.label: MSFE Practicum Project
ns2:course.description: Application of mathematical, statistical, computing, machine learning and data analytics tools to a real life financial engineering team project sponsored by the industry. Projects in each semester are different and may require different skill sets. Regular meetings with the sponsor required. May be repeated in separate terms for a total of 8 hours. Prerequisite: IE 522, FIN 500, and MSFE program approval. Restricted to MS: Financial Engineering Students only.
